name: film-archlang-2d-3d
description: Feature explainer film for ArchLang: one .arch file becomes a dimensioned 2D plan and a 3D preview.

scripts.gates: node scripts/gate-copy.mjs && node scripts/gate-facts.mjs && node scripts/gate-logo.mjs
scripts.render:en: node scripts/heavy-guard.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts MasterEN out/archlang-2d-3d-en-16x9.mp4 --concurrency=1 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=500000000 --offthreadvideo-video-threads=1 --media-cache-size-in-bytes=300000000 && node scripts/master.mjs out/archlang-2d-3d-en-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:cut30: node scripts/heavy-guard.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Cut30 out/cut-30s-en-16x9.mp4 --concurrency=1 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=500000000 --offthreadvideo-video-threads=1 --media-cache-size-in-bytes=300000000 && node scripts/master.mjs out/cut-30s-en-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:cut30v: node scripts/heavy-guard.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Cut30Vertical out/cut-30s-en-9x16.mp4 --concurrency=1 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=500000000 --offthreadvideo-video-threads=1 --media-cache-size-in-bytes=300000000 && node scripts/master.mjs out/cut-30s-en-9x16.mp4
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/poster-16x9.png --frame=0 && remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/thumb-1280x720.png --frame=0 --scale=0.6667
